QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Spell-Breaking
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Professor Beatrice at the Ranheim Academy.
QuestInfo.1: Go to #bCorrupted Magic Forest 3#k and collect #b10 Magic Orbs#k from the #bCorrupted Advanced Magicians#k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Beatrice all the Magic Orbs she needed.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#

Can proceed to [Kritias] The Absent Pentacle

0.0: Will you look at that? A spell wrapped around a spell wrapped around a spellbook. Try to break the one, and the other will explode...\r\n#L0##bSo we can't break the spell?#l\n#k
0.1:
Not by force, unless you want to cause a blast that will knock the trans-universal axes into a extra-mythic spin.
But maybe we don't have to break the spell. After all, the magicians carrying these books read them somehow, didn't they?
#L0##bBut how?#l
#k
0.2: I would imagine they used #bMagic Orbs#k as a sort of key. Those doodads are handy for storing all manner of spells.\r\n#L0##bThen we need their Magic Orbs.#l\n#k
0.3: That's right. You got these from #bCorrupted Advanced Magicians#k? Then they'll have the orbs we need. Bring me some #bMagic Orbs#k from the #bCorrupted Advanced Magicians#k and I'll see what I can do.

yes.0: It'll be hard to know which Magic Orb will unlock these books, so grab as many as you can.
yes.1: The more, the better. Let's start with #b10#k.

no.0: As you wish. It's no skin off my chakras.

yes.0:
One of these orbs should decentrify the spell's energetic matrix. 
...

... ... ... Got it.

item.0: #bCorrupted Advanced Magicians#k wander about the #bCorrupted Magic Forest 3#k. They had the spellbooks, so they must have the #bMagic Orbs#k too.
